tools.name: get_event_info
tools.description: Get the canonical Bitcoin Amsterdam 2026 event details: name, dates, venue, city, and the official URL.

tools.name: open_contact_form
tools.description: Open the contact page with a specific inquiry tab pre-selected (general, sponsor, speaker, group-passes, bitcoin-week, media-partnership, media-inquiry, press-pass, affiliate-partner, community-partner).

tab.description: Which contact form tab to open.

tools.name: open_tickets_page
tools.description: Navigate the current browser tab to the Bitcoin Amsterdam tickets page. Optionally apply a promo code automatically.

promoCode.description: Optional promo code to auto-apply (e.g. PASSQUIZ for 10% off).

tools.name: start_pass_quiz
tools.description: Navigate to the 5-question pass-type quiz that recommends the right Bitcoin Amsterdam pass and surfaces the PASSQUIZ 10% promo code on completion.
